verification_method: Each licence number was entered into the CSLB 'Check a Contractor License' lookup and the resulting LicenseDetail page read directly. The CSLB page footer on every record read 'Data current as of 11/6/2026'. No value below comes from a directory, aggregator, or the contractor's own marketing.
rating_columns_note: Yelp ratings and review counts are deliberately blank: Yelp business pages returned HTTP 403 to automated retrieval on 2026-11-06, so no rating could be verified. Blank = not verified, not zero.
fit_rubric: G1 - holds an active C-36 plumbing classification (hard requirement for the plumbing scope)
G2 - can also cover the drywall/ceiling repair: holds B general building, or a C-9 partner
G3 - business address in San Francisco (fastest dispatch, city business registration likely current)
G4 - workers' compensation on file (not merely exempt for no employees)
G5 - self-published evidence of bath waste-and-overflow work
G6 - no CSLB advisory or disciplinary note on the record

vendors.name: Ace Plumbing & Rooter, Inc.
classifications: C-4 - BOILER, HOT WATER HEATING AND STEAM FITTING
vendors.why: Only shortlisted firm that holds BOTH an active C-36 plumbing licence and a B general building licence, so one licensed entity can own the plumbing and the ceiling repair end to end. San Francisco address, workers' comp on file, no advisory on the record.
vendors.open_question: No self-published example of bath waste-and-overflow work was found. Ask for two comparable concealed-waste jobs.
